verdict.rationale: Fern documents that every documentation site with Ask Fern enabled gets an automatically generated, production-ready MCP server that connects AI clients (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf) to the docs as an external data source for search and page content, letting readers' agents get instant answers within their dev environment. This is corroborated by a dedicated docs page and probe confirming the feature is documented. Missing for 10: independent (non-vendor) hands-on verification that the MCP server works end-to-end in practice.
